sloka: यथा शुष्काण्यरण्यानि ग्रीष्मे दहति पावकः।तथा वानरसैन्यानि कुम्भकर्णो विनिर्दहत् ।। ६.६७.४० ।।
transliteration: yathā śuṣkāṇyaraṇyāni grīṣme dahati pāvakaḥ।tathā vānarasainyāni kumbhakarṇo vinirdahat ।। 6.67.40 ।।

translations.english: That terrible Rakshasa swooning and wetting the ground with flesh and blood ranged through the army of Vanaras like fire at the time of dissolution of the universe.
